readings.Aries: Someone is ready to follow your lead. Be worth following. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Taurus: Slowness is a form of intelligence. The world will argue otherwise. You are correct. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Gemini: You contain multitudes and you know it. Today, pick one and inhabit it fully. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Cancer: There is a conversation you need to have that you keep replacing with acts of service. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Virgo: There is a question about yourself that your analysis keeps circling. Land on it. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Libra: There is indecision, and then there is gathering information. Know which you're doing. Let this one be easy.
readings.Scorpio: Your perception of betrayal is accurate. What you do with that perception is still yours to decide. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Sagittarius: The fire in you is generative and occasionally destructive. Today, mind the surroundings. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Capricorn: The plan is good. The plan will need adjustment. Plan for that too. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Aquarius: Your originality is not a strategy — it's your nature. Trust it even when it confuses people. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like surrendering is actually arriving. Let yourself arrive. This is a better week for listening than speaking.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
